'''2010 Canadian Nationals Alex O'Shea DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' Three-for-all
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
